exams.name: Public Adjuster Examination
exams.notes: Examination required before issuance of license; exemptions exist for renewal applicants, reciprocal-state licensees, and those who completed an approved training program with examination.
exams.quote: Each applicant for a license as a public adjuster, before the issuance of such license, shall personally take and pass, to the satisfaction of the commissioner, an examination as a test of his qualifications and competency

interval_years.quote: The privilege license of an individual to act as a public adjuster shall continue from the date of issuance for original licenses or from the expiration date for existing licenses until the last day of the month of the licensee's birthday in the second year following issuance or renewal of the license, with a minimum term of thirteen (13) months.

required.quote: Every individual seeking renewal of a public adjuster license, which has been in effect for a term of more than eighteen (18) months shall satisfactorily complete twenty-four (24) hours of study in approved continuing education courses

hours_per_period.quote: Every individual seeking renewal of a public adjuster license, which has been in effect for a term of more than eighteen (18) months shall satisfactorily complete twenty-four (24) hours of study in approved continuing education courses

available.quote: The commissioner may waive any license requirement for an applicant with a valid license from another state having license requirements substantially equivalent to those of this state.

bonding_required.quote: A surety bond executed and issued by an insurer authorized to issue surety bonds in Mississippi, which bond shall: a. Be in the minimum amount of Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000.00)

definition_quote.value: any person who, for direct, indirect, or any other compensation or any other thing of value on behalf of the insured: (i) Acts or aids, solely in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of the insured, on behalf of an insured in negotiating for, or effecting the settlement of, a claim for loss or damage covered by an insurance contract; (ii) Advertises for employment as a public adjuster of insurance claims or solicits business or represents himself or herself to the public as a public adjuster of first party insurance claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance that insure real or personal property; or (iii) Directly or indirectly solicits business, investigates or adjusts losses, or advises an insured about first party claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance that insure real or personal property for another person engaged in the business of adjusting losses or damages covered by an insurance policy, for the insured.
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjuster" means any person who, for direct, indirect, or any other compensation or any other thing of value on behalf of the insured

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A business entity applying for a resident public adjuster license shall make an application to the commissioner on the appropriate uniform business entity application

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: Has designated a licensed adjuster or public adjuster responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and regulations of Mississippi

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: A business entity applying for a resident public adjuster license shall make an application to the commissioner ... A nonresident person applying for a nonresident public adjuster license must show

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: A public adjuster shall not have a financial interest in any salvage, repair or any other business entity that obtains business in connection with any claim that the public adjuster has a contract to adjust.

surety_bond_required.quote: Obtain a bond or irrevocable letter of credit prior to issuance of a license and shall maintain the bond or letter of credit for the duration of the license

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: Be in the minimum amount of Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000.00)

written_contract_required.quote: Public adjusters shall ensure that all contracts for their services are in writing, signed by the insured and the public adjuster who solicited the contract, and a copy of the contract shall be provided to the insured upon execution.

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: A public adjuster's contract with the insured shall be revocable or cancelable by the insured without cause and without penalty or obligation for at least five (5) business days after the contract is executed by the insured.

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: A public adjuster shall not participate, directly or indirectly, in the reconstruction, repair or restoration of damaged property that is the subject of a claim adjusted by the adjuster.

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: the commissioner may levy a civil penalty in an amount not to exceed Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) per violation
